records.orientation: TV drama · Yomiuri TV / NTV Sunday Drama · 12 Jan – 15 Mar 2020 · 10 episodes
records.character: Kawata Ren (later revealed as twin Riko), 23, a struggling go player (Nana Seino)
records.hypnotist: Medical student and 'mentalist' Morishima Naoki (Ryusei Yokohama), acting for 'Mr. No Compliance'
records.mechanism: Literal hypnosis with a trigger: when Naoki pours syrup in a spiral on a pancake (or other liquids), Ren falls into a trance and becomes the vigilante 'Miss Panda' without knowing it.
records.summary: Ren, 23, a once-prodigy go player, has a crush on medical student Naoki. He uses a hypnotic trigger to turn her, unknowingly, into the masked vigilante Miss Panda, whom he directs as her 'zookeeper' to expose hidden truths in scandals. Her past (twin sister, childhood memory rewrite by her psychiatrist) is unravelled across the series.
records.fit_note: LITERAL HYPNOSIS without her knowledge or consent (syrup trigger, episode 1 onward). Her childhood memory rewrite by Dr. Kadota was requested by her as a child and is NOT the basis of this card. In the finale, memory erasure is requested by Riko and is consensual; the qualifying control is Naoki's ongoing covert trigger.
records.relationship: Unrequited crush on Naoki, who has a fiancée (Azusa); not married.

records.orientation: TV drama · tvN · 2 Dec 2016 – 21 Jan 2017 · 16 episodes
records.character: Sunny (Yoo In-na), an adult chicken-restaurant owner
records.hypnotist: The Grim Reaper (Lee Dong-wook), who is dating her
records.mechanism: LOOSE FIT — supernatural memory-erasing gaze that press calls 최면술 (hypnotism): 'look into my eyes', followed by commands she obeys trance-like.
records.summary: A centuries-old goblin seeks his bride to end his immortality while sharing a house with a grim reaper. In episode 8 the Grim Reaper, suddenly in pain while walking with Sunny, uses his hypnotic power on her without asking: 'we didn't meet today… go home', and she walks away as if spellbound.
records.fit_note: LOOSE FIT (supernatural trance power) — non-consensual memory hypnosis of an adult woman. Kiss Goblin (2020) in the catalog is a different work.

records.title: Sirr al-Amira / سر الأميرة
records.orientation: Feature film · dir. Niazi Mustafa · Koka, Ahmed El-Bey, Kamal El-Shennawy
records.character: Fodda (Koka), an adult Upper-Egyptian heiress from Luxor
records.hypnotist: Daoud Shahriyar (Ahmed El-Bey), a charlatan antiquities dealer and hypnotist
records.mechanism: Hypnosis after he gives her sedative pills: he keeps her under hypnotic control and passes her off as the spirit of the Pharaonic princess Ahura to make money from 'miracle cures'.
records.summary: Fleeing a cousin who covets her inheritance and believing she caused a death, Fodda falls into the hands of charlatan Daoud. He drugs and hypnotizes her and exhibits her as the spirit of Princess Ahura, earning fame and money in Luxor and Cairo. Love for Wahid helps her resist his control; Wahid exposes the hypnosis, marries her, and later unmasks the blackmail plot.
records.fit_note: LITERAL HYPNOSIS (with sedative pills) against her will, for exploitation and fraud.
records.relationship: Marries Wahid (Kamal El-Shennawy) mid-film; Daoud keeps blackmailing her after the wedding.
records.confidence_flag: High: El Cinema full plot; ESOA works database and Arabic Wikipedia confirm credits.

records.orientation: Vertical short drama · NetShort (Arabic) · cover dated Apr 2025
records.character: Sara Al-Omari, an adult wealthy wife
records.hypnotist: Her husband Adel Al-Fahd, via a love spell / potion ('antidote')
records.mechanism: LOOSE FIT — love magic / potion that keeps her devoted and controlled while he loots her fortune; she later breaks it with help.
records.summary: Sara is under a love spell her husband Adel uses to control her and plunder her fortune while he cheats with her friend Reem and plots to get rid of her. Lawyer Karim, who returned from a past life in which he saw her die, helps her break the spell; she pretends to stay enchanted while planning her revenge.
records.fit_note: LOOSE FIT (spell/potion control, not literal hypnosis) — real, non-consensual control of an adult wife by her husband. Flagged loose fit per brief.
records.relationship: Married to Adel; he is unfaithful with Reem.
